PURBASHA GRAMIN BANK
(A fictional bank) · Dhanbad Branch

Date: 16th October 2026

To,
Dipankar Das
167, Kali Mandir Lane, Dhanbad, Jharkhand - 826001

Sub: Reminder for overdue instalments in Loan Account No. 554650795154

Dear Customer,

This is to inform you that 1 EMI(s) of Rs. 6,120/- each in your above loan account are overdue since 12th September 2026. The total overdue amount is Rs. 6,120/-, and penal interest of Rs. 122/- has been levied as per the sanction terms.

You are requested to pay Rs. 6,242/- on or before 31st October 2026 to regularise the account.

Please note that if the dues are not cleared, the account will be classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) on 11th December 2026, which will affect your credit score, and the Bank may initiate recovery proceedings as per law.

If you have already paid, please ignore this letter.

Yours faithfully,
Branch Manager
